headline: As of 2026-11-03: 62,475,535 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+7.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 62,475,535 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+7.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,913,956), California (7,202,817), Florida (6,928,413).
